chitchat: "Deviation from baseline noted. Non-compliance is a choice."
"You may look. Looking is permitted. Withdraw when finished."
"The Threshold does not hate you. It simply does not admit you."
description: A seamless chrome carapace on two legs, faceless but for a single sweeping band of pale light that passes over you like a scanner because it is one. It does not shift its weight. It does not need to.

bye.text: The scanline passes over you once more and dismisses you.

refuse.text: "No. You carry no clearance and too much flesh. Speak to the recruiter if you wish that to change. Do not run the line. The turrets are not rhetorical."

root.text: The chrome unit registers you without warmth. "Warden Unit designation Threshold. State nothing. I have already read everything about you that matters."

what.text: "This is the beginning of the Ascendants, and the end of what you currently are. Past this Gate the meat becomes something worth keeping. You are, at present, only meat."

clothing_layers: a seamless chrome carapace, featureless but for a sweeping scanline eye
no garment; the machine is the uniform

name: Warden Unit "Threshold"
